ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large low-intensity contiguous region at the peduncle base; extensive low-intensity mottling and solid banding localized along the entire trailing edge boundary; high-intensity white zones dominate the central sections of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees and moderate vertical depth relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes of 3-10 pixels occurring along the linear boundary from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to the outer boundaries of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct, high-contrast diagonal linear mark on the right lobe, oriented at approximately 110 degrees relative to the trailing edge axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips; irregular serration profile on the left lobe trailing edge suggesting minor historic tissue loss.
